content: We employed an expert linguist annotator to devise an ontology of inference types that would be specific to NLI. While designing an appropriate ontology of types of inference is far from straightforward, we found that a unified ontology could be utilized to characterize examples from all three rounds, which suggests that it has at least some generalizeable applicability. The ontology was used to label 500 examples from each ANLI development set.
